title: Article: The Concept Of How To Build Networth In Astral World

segments.text: What Is Astral Worth?
When we talk about worth , most people think of money. But in reality , worth is measured very differently — not by wealth, but by connections .

Every soul has an astral identity and astral network , and these connections define one’s recognition and power in the unseen worlds. Before understanding astral worth, let’s first explore how spiritual power and recognition actually form.
The Power of an Enlightened Being
When a person becomes truly spiritual — one who can bring divine energy to Earth — they reach a state similar to a deity. Such a person carries tremendous astral power .

When such an enlightened soul gives a boon or a curse , the universe itself aligns to fulfill it. It may appear that a deity has blessed or cursed someone, but in truth, it is the devotee’s astral power being reflected through the deity’s energy.
This means — deities themselves never curse or bless directly ; it is their devotees , whose deep spiritual connections channel that divine action.

So, when people say, “This person was cursed by a certain deity,” in reality, it was a devotee of that deity whose words carried that energy. The strength of a spiritual being lies in the depth of their connection — both to divine energies and to the astral network around them.
Power in the Physical and Astral Worlds

In the physical world , we call someone powerful based on their influence or strength. For example, a commander who leads battles and has thousands under his command is seen as powerful. His aura often appears strong and expansive because of the connections he holds — his soldiers, followers, and the energies tied to his actions.
On the other hand, a peaceful person who hasn’t built such networks may not have a large aura.
Power, therefore, in both the physical and astral realms, comes from connection — the energetic links a person creates through action, devotion, or leadership.
How Devotion Builds Astral Value
Let’s understand this with a simple comparison.
Imagine a businessman who has spent 35 years building a glass industry. Over time, not only does he accumulate wealth, but he also becomes well-known and respected within that field.
Even if he runs short of money someday, he can still raise funds easily — not because of cash in hand , but because of his reputation . His name has value in the market.
Now, shift this idea to the astral world .

If a person sincerely performs mantra chanting for hours every day — say 6 hours — over time, they start gaining recognition in the astral realm. Just like reputation attracts opportunities in business, astral recognition attracts energy, abundance, and support from higher forces.

That is why many spiritual healers or astrologers can manifest wealth — their astral identity is recognized among various energies and entities in that world. Their aura becomes known, respected, and connected.
Astral Recognition and Flow of Energy
Once a person becomes recognized astrally, all forms of energies — divine or dark — start acknowledging them.
Their astral body begins to travel across temples, sacred sites, or higher realms, building deeper connections. This happens even without their conscious effort.
The more connections a person builds astrally, the stronger and more stable they become — both spiritually and materially.
Just as networking helps a person grow in the business world, astral networking sustains and uplifts one’s spiritual and physical life.
Recognition in the astral world is not just an achievement — it is a necessity .
Without astral recognition, one’s energy flow weakens; with it, even material success becomes easier. Because just like in the physical world, in the astral world too —
“Money is a byproduct of fame, and fame is the result of your astral connections.”
The more value your name holds in the astral realm, the more effortlessly life begins to support you.
How to Increase Your Astral worth

In the astral world, your worth is determined by the number and quality of connections you hold. Just as business networking increases your worth in the physical world, spiritual connections raise your worth in the astral world. This is where astrology, rituals, and devotion all play their part — but at different levels of depth.
The Role of Astrology: Creating Astral Links
When an astrologer suggests a remedy — for example, visiting a temple, performing a ritual, or offering something specific — they are essentially guiding you to create a new astral connection .

Every time you do a ritual or make an offering, you exchange energy with the astral forces present at that place. The offering acts as a bridge — you give something, and in return, you receive energy or support from the entities that reside there.

That’s why remedies and rituals work . They are not just symbolic acts; they are energetic transactions. Whether it’s astrology, healing, or any other form of spiritual work, everything functions through astral connection and exchange .
The stronger your astral connections become, the more stable and prosperous your life energy grows — both physically and spiritually.
Devotion: Strengthening the Roots
Now, let’s understand this from the path of Devotion .

When a person engages in deep Devotion, they begin to strengthen their foundation — their spiritual roots . In simple terms, Devotion doesn’t require gemstones or external supports; it directly nourishes the soul’s base.
But here’s where many devotees get stuck:
Even after years of devotion, they may not feel progress. Why? Because their Pitra (ancestral energies) might be standing in the way.

When a person begins to form divine connections through Devotion, these connections are not always received by the devotee themselves. Many times, the Pitra energies intercept those blessings and draw them towards themselves. As a result, the devotee keeps doing Devotion, but the benefits — recognition, energy, or divine grace — flow towards the ancestors instead.

Over time, these Pitra become very powerful in the astral world because they are feeding on the devotee’s Devotion energy. They even ensure that the person continues the same routine of worship so that this energetic flow remains uninterrupted.
Clearing the Path of Devotion

On the path of Devotion , one must first clear the influence of Pitra energies . These ancestral energies often stand between the devotee and the divine, silently absorbing the blessings and power meant for the devotee. Once these energies are acknowledged and released, the path becomes open — allowing the devotee to connect directly with Param Shakti , the supreme divine source.

When this happens, dependence on astrology, remedies, or external rituals naturally fades away. The devotee’s connection is now pure and direct. Their inner energy becomes radiant — powerful enough to attract divine recognition on its own. The astral body begins to form connections across higher realms effortlessly, as if the universe itself starts networking on their behalf.
Guided by the Power of Guru Tattva

The real transformation in a devotee’s journey begins only under the guidance of a true Guru Tattva. The Guru acts as a divine compass — refining one’s energy, aligning astral flow, and guiding safely through higher realms. With the Guru’s grace, even unseen forces start supporting you, turning effort into effortless growth.

Under this divine alignment, money, fame, and opportunities begin to flow naturally — not as things to chase, but as byproducts of divine recognition. Because in both the physical and astral worlds, one eternal truth stands strong:
“Recognition brings value, value attracts energy, and energy manifests as prosperity.”

That’s why Devotion should always be practiced under the Guru’s guidance. Without it, even sincere devotion can lose direction. A true Guru not only channels your energy correctly but also protects you from astral diversions and wrong paths. Only through the Guru Tattva can Devotion lead to real growth, transformation, and divine connection.
How Ashaeiynn Helps Aspirants Build Astral Connections and Worth

At Ashaeiynn , regular homa (havan) is performed without interruption, and it plays a crucial role in building an aspirant’s astral connections and worth . During homa, divine energies from multiple realms are invited , opening portals that link these energies with those who attend.

By participating consistently, aspirants gradually become recognized in the astral world , strengthening their spiritual presence. For instance, an Ashaeiynn aspirant visiting a famous spiritual site had his wish fulfilled immediately because his astral recognition and connections were already established , and the divine energies acknowledged him.

Through attending regular homa at Ashaeiynn , an aspirant’s astral body is called daily, forming direct connections with saints and divine energies. These connections happen naturally under the guidance of Guru Tattva , without needing extra remedies.
Attending homa regularly builds astral recognition.
Money, fame, and opportunities arrive as a byproduct , not as the goal.
Energy generated from offerings is maximized through devotion, benefiting future generations .

Even lifelong attendance at Ashaeiynn homa is free after the initial contribution because connections matter more than money . The more one contributes to the energy of the homa, the more astral power is generated.
Why Money Should Never Be the Main Focus

Money is only a byproduct of fame, recognition, and connections. Focusing solely on earning money will not make a person truly powerful or strong. Instead, the main goal should be to build connections and become recognized. Once recognition comes, money will naturally follow.

Chasing money alone is like worshipping Lakshmi without Narayan Tattva . True prosperity requires both—Lakshmi (wealth energy) and Narayan Tattva (Purush Tattva). You cannot achieve this through short-term fixes like gems or remedies.

To grow both spiritually and materially, regular Devotion—through meditation, mantra chanting, or other spiritual practices—is essential. If you don’t practice it now, someone in your future generations will eventually have to, because spiritual growth can only be achieved through Devotion.
Connections vs. Money
• Money comes and goes, but connections last forever.
• In this world, strong relationships help you sustain wealth and success, but in the astral world, divine connections earned through Devotion bring lasting recognition and spiritual power.
• Even if you don’t have big worldly contacts or come from a modest background, you can still build powerful astral recognition by regular devotion through mantra chanting, meditation, and homa.
True power isn’t in collecting money—it’s in being recognized in both the physical and astral worlds. Money fades, but connections stay with you forever.
Connections — The Real Wealth

We’re not saying you shouldn’t earn money. Earn it, but earn it wisely. Let it meet your needs and support your life—not become your obsession. When money becomes the main focus, it loses its purpose. Our Guru Tattva teaches that money without connections doesn’t create fame or power. So, don’t make money your main goal—make connections your foundation.

This is something we should also teach our children. A person who has strong connections—physical or astral—will naturally become prosperous. These connections will benefit their future generations far more than saved money ever can.

Think about it: people who’ve run successful businesses for 20 years have built a strong network. Their children inherit not just wealth but the connections that sustain that wealth. Even in the film industry, many stars who rose from humble beginnings did so because of their connections with already established names. Fame and success always follow connection, not cash.
The Power of Astral Connections

For those who don’t have big worldly networks, astral connections become a divine path. Through Devotion—regular mantra chanting, homa, and meditation—you can form connections with higher beings, saints, and divine energies. When that happens, money, opportunities, and recognition begin to flow naturally as byproducts.
Even after leaving the body, a person known in the astral world continues to hold power. Their astral connections become blessings that support their family and future generations.

If you struggle to make worldly connections or manage your energy here, start in the astral world. Devotion is your bridge. But remember—before walking that path, clear the pitra blockages that may stand in the way of your devotion. That’s why understanding the astral world is so essential.
And above all, to build strong connections—whether physical or astral— you must first be good from within. True connections recognize purity, humility, and sincerity.
Final Thought:
Your true worth isn’t measured by the money you hold, but by the connections you build — both in the physical world and the astral one.
